links.comparator_used: Pretrained models (primary model and public EchoNet-Dynamic) applied to phone-recorded videos without phone-video fine-tuning
links.outcome: LVEF estimation accuracy on phone-recorded echocardiogram videos (MAE, R², AUROC for EF >50%)
links.effect: Primary model without fine-tuning on phone videos: MAE 7.00 pp, R² 0.49, AUROC 0.91; after fine-tuning on the 2396-video evaluation cohort: MAE 6.96 pp, R² 0.61, AUROC 0.93. EchoNet-Dynamic: MAE 9.36 to 7.86 pp, R² 0.37 to 0.50, AUROC 0.84 to 0.89.
links.quote: On the 2396-video fine-tuning evaluation cohort, fine-tuning improved primary model performance to a mean absolute error of 6.96 percentage points, coefficient of determination of 0.61, and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.93.
